The '''Gafsa''' was a canyon in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In the [[Tusken/Legends|Tusken]] language, the name meant the 'Waking Place', and according to the traditions of the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] recorded by [[Alkhara/Legends|Alkhara]] in the [[600 BBY/Legends|sixth century]] [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], it was the location where they had first stepped forth on the planet. The Gafsa was of great importance to the Sand People, and merely trespassing could lead to a violent situation.

The Gafsa was the location of a rare sacred Tusken [[Water/Legends|water]] well, and in the years around the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], it was used as a bivouac by the Tusken clan led by [[Sharad Hett]].
